title: The Autopsy of Greywater Bay
author: August Montrose
blurb: Vesper Crane, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must close the one case everyone swore was closed for good before the tide gives up what it took.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
